args.source: Controller macros bound to keys: M=Cross, N=Circle, I=Up, K=Down, J=Left, L=Right, O=Start, P=R2, B=Triangle. A press toggles the button on and a second press toggles it off, so every action needs two key presses with observation between them. Space toggles emulator pause; F7 frame-advance; F8 screenshot; Shift+F8 single-frame GSDump. Starting states under sstates: slot 99 = main menu (boot default), slot 98 = 'Select a Challenge Theme / Living Legends' car-selection strip, slots 93/95/96/97 = in-race/other, slot 100 = paused Quick Race at zero MPH position 6/6 (current live state).
